description: This file defines the DefaultEventHubReceiverMonitor class which extends DefaultQueueAdapterReceiverMonitor. It is responsible for tracking metrics for EventHub receivers using logging facilities, specifically tailored for Orleans streaming with Event Hubs. The class includes a constructor that initializes dimension properties related to the Event Hub path and partition.

classes.name: DefaultEventHubReceiverMonitor
classes.description: Monitors EventHub receiver metrics, extending DefaultQueueAdapterReceiverMonitor, with specific support for EventHub dimensions.

methods.name: DefaultEventHubReceiverMonitor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the monitor with specific EventHub dimensions, setting path and partition metrics for tracking.
